description: NexGen Wafersystems MG Series (MG21/MG22/MG22-300) event subscription, generated by scripts/gen_mg_subscription.py from eap_middleware.profiles:NEXGEN_MG_REPORTS. Do not hand-edit. Each entry carries a 'band': the middleware issues S2F33/S2F35/S2F37 once per band so a CEID a given MG variant does not implement degrades one family instead of voiding the whole subscription. Events with an empty 'rptids' list have no valid data variables in the manual and are enabled WITHOUT being linked - sending an empty RPTID list would delete the link.
_source: NWS MG Series SECS/GEM Documentation V1.1.18 (01.04.2025), sections 8.1 / 8.2
_warning: Documentation-derived and NOT hardware-verified. The manual states CEIDs, VIDs and processing-state numbers may change without prior notice.
